Park held 1.66M shares of the hospital and nursing management company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $119.60 million, down from 1.97M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Park West Asset Management Llc who had been investing in Davita Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $11.89 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.80% or $0.54 during the last trading session, reaching $68.12. About 1.21 million shares traded. DaVita Inc. (NYSE:DVA) has declined 2.38% since May 19, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 13.93% the S&P500.
Park West Asset Management Llc, which manages about $1.77B and $2.19 billion US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Blackhawk Network Hldgs Inc (NASDAQ:HAWK) by 289,728 shares to 1.79M shares, valued at $63.80 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Social Cap Hedosophia Hldgs by 526,564 shares in the quarter, for a total of 1.63 million shares, and has risen its stake in Heska Corp (NASDAQ:HSKA).
Analysts await DaVita Inc. (NYSE:DVA) to report earnings on August, 7. They expect $0.98 earnings per share, up 6.52 % or $0.06 from last year’s $0.92 per share. DVA’s profit will be $171.01 million for 17.38 P/E if the $0.98 EPS becomes a reality. After $1.05 actual earnings per share reported by DaVita Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -6.67 % negative EPS growth.
